# crosswork_credential_profiles (Data Source)

This data source can read the Credential Profiles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_credential_profiles" "example" {
  id = "cwtest-profile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) List of credentials, one per access type (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `profile` (String) Credential profile name
- `snmpv2_read_community` (String) SNMPv2 read community
- `snmpv2_read_community_wo` (String) SNMPv2 read community
- `snmpv2_read_community_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `snmpv2_read_community_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `snmpv2_write_community` (String) SNMPv2 write community
- `snmpv2_write_community_wo` (String) SNMPv2 write community
- `snmpv2_write_community_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `snmpv2_write_community_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `snmpv3_auth_password` (String) SNMPv3 authentication password
- `snmpv3_auth_password_wo` (String) SNMPv3 authentication password
- `snmpv3_auth_password_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `snmpv3_auth_password_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `snmpv3_auth_type` (String) SNMPv3 authentication type
- `snmpv3_priv_password` (String) SNMPv3 privacy password
- `snmpv3_priv_password_wo` (String) SNMPv3 privacy password
- `snmpv3_priv_password_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `snmpv3_priv_password_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `snmpv3_priv_type` (String) SNMPv3 privacy type
- `snmpv3_security_level` (String) SNMPv3 security level
- `snmpv3_user_name` (String) SNMPv3 user name

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `enable_password` (String) Second level authentication, for devices that support it
- `enable_password_value` (String) Enable password
- `enable_password_value_wo` (String) Enable password
- `enable_password_value_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `enable_password_value_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `password` (String) Password
- `password_wo` (String) Password
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `password_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `type` (String) Access type
- `user_name` (String) User name
